mapper.sql: music_log_id, member_id, track_name, artist_name, album_name, genre, tags, lastfm_track_url, discogs_release_id, cover_image_url, listened_date, memo, created_at, updated_at
mapper.update: UPDATE music_log SET track_name = #{trackName}, artist_name = #{artistName}, album_name = #{albumName}, genre = #{genre}, tags = #{tags}, lastfm_track_url = #{lastfmTrackUrl}, discogs_release_id = #{discogsReleaseId}, cover_image_url = #{coverImageUrl}, listened_date = #{listenedDate}, memo = #{memo}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE music_log_id = #{musicLogId} AND member_id = #{memberId}
mapper.select: SELECT tags, COUNT(*) AS usage_count FROM music_log WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND tags IS NOT NULL AND tags != '' GROUP BY tags ORDER BY MAX(listened_date) DESC LIMIT #{limit}
